dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Friends, you who have come to this abandoned lake shelter, feel free to take anything you need.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Possessions that are useless to us may yet save another from disaster.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Remember the order — Start by the chair, in the water, by the fire, and finally, on the wall.
